subject: file upload messing with class of dataset

messages.author: 71cdc2d1ceb324f4
messages.subject: file upload messing with class of dataset
parts:
I have used the typical code in shiny to allow for a file to be uploaded and set the maximum capacity to be 30MB. However when I upload a file of >20MB for some reason the upload messes with the class of the dataset data frame being uploaded.


#ui.R
......
fileInput('file1', 'Choose file to upload',
              accept = c(
                'text/csv',
                'text/comma-separated-values',
                'text/tab-separated-values',
                'text/plain',
                '.csv',
                '.tsv'
              )
    ),
tableOutput("table"),
......

#server.R
....
dataInput1 <- eventReactive(input$choices, {
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    isolate(t<-t(read.table(inFile$datapath, header = T,
                          sep = "\t")))
output$table<-renderTable({ print(dim(dataInput1()))
     })
....

Although the table will not render to the webpage, it will render to the command line (returning the correct dimensions of the table)

But the following error appears on the webpage:

Error in UseMethod: no applicable method for 'xtable' applied to an object of class "c('integer', 'numeric')"

does anyone know how this is happening and how to rectify it?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: file upload messing with class of dataset
parts: tableOutput/renderTable is for rendering the actual data frame as a table. If you just want to render the dimensions, use verbatimTextOutput and renderText, and don't bother with print()--just return the values themselves.
